name: serpapi_ebay_search
description: Search eBay listings via SerpApi (engine ebay). Returns normalized organic_results (title, url, product_id, serpapi_link for ebay_product drill-down, price, condition, shipping line, seller, thumbnail). Prefer default caching: only set no_cache=true when you need freshly scraped pages (fresh listing state); omitting no_cache uses SerpApi cache and is faster. Docs: https://serpapi.com/ebay-search-api

query.description: eBay search keywords (maps to SerpApi _nkw). Optional when category_id is set.

category_id.description: Optional eBay category id to constrain the search (_nkw can be omitted).

ebay_domain.description: eBay site host, default ebay.com (see SerpApi eBay domains list).

_blrs.description: Exclude auto-corrected query; recommended value spell_auto_correct when needed.

show_only.description: Comma-separated filters: Complete, Sold, FR, RPA, AS, Savings, SaleItems, Lots, Charity, AV, FS, LPickup, etc.

buying_format.description: Auction, BIN, BO (comma-separated allowed by API).

_sop.description: Sort option code (SerpApi eBay sort options).

_stpos.description: ZIP or postal code for shipping-area bias.

LH_ItemCondition.description: Condition id(s), pipe-separated for multiple (eBay condition id values).

LH_PrefLoc.description: Preferred seller location: Domestic, Regional, or Worldwide.

num_results.description: Max listings to normalize for the LLM (clamped 1–5, default 3). Raising wastes context; widen only when the user explicitly needs more rows.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache. Default false (faster, cached responses do not consume quota).

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi parameters forwarded as-is except reserved keys.

include_raw.description: Include full SerpApi JSON under data.raw.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
